page_title: JUV 2-0 PAR | Juventus v Parma 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

90+4' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Parma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+2' Adrian Benedyczak (Parma) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends the corner into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts it and averts the threat.
89' It's time for a substitution. Weston McKennie (Juventus) comes on in place of Kenan Yildiz.
88' Carlos Cuesta has decided to make a change. Milan Djuric (Parma) replaces Mandela Keita.
88' Substitution. Mathias Lovik is replaced by Nahuel Estevez (Parma).

88' A neat pass finds Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the roof of the net, but Michele Di Gregorio denies him with a good save. The referee signals a corner kick to Parma.
87' The resulting corner from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) comes to nothing.
86' Mandela Keita (Parma) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar.
84' 2 - 0 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Kenan Yildiz inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
83' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
82' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
81' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
80' The substitution is prepared. Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Francisco Conceicao.
80' Carlos Cuesta prepares a substitution. Pontus Almqvist is replaced by Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
80' Jonathan David will be replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).

79' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Zion Suzuki is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
77' Wasted opportunity! Lautaro Valenti (Parma) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
72' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Zion Suzuki is equal to it and makes an easy save.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oliver Sorensen (Parma) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.

65' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Zion Suzuki pulls off an easy save.
64' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul.
59' 1 - 0 Goal! Kenan Yildiz provides Jonathan David (Juventus) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
59' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
59' Jonathan David (Juventus) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out. Juventus force a corner. They send men into the box.
57' Manuel Locatelli goes off the pitch and Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) comes on.
57' Substitution. Federico Gatti did his best and is replaced by Joao Mario (Juventus).
57' Here is a change. Christian Ordonez is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Oliver Sorensen (Parma).
56' None of the Juventus players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
56' Zion Suzuki (Parma) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!

55' A lofted cross from Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
54' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
54' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matteo Marcenaro saw the whole situation.
51' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the right post.
50' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
48' That was close by Federico Gatti (Juventus)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
47' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
46' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The resulting corner from Christian Ordonez (Parma) is cleared.
45' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Parma.
43' Igor Tudor (Juventus) gets a yellow card, off the field.
43' Jonathan David (Juventus) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

42' Bremer (Juventus) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball goes well wide of the right post!
40' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
40' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. Juventus force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
39' The corner from Christian Ordonez (Parma) is intercepted by the defence.
38' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Parma win a corner kick.

35' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Zion Suzuki pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
35' Bremer (Juventus) is able to continue to play.
33' Bremer (Juventus) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
32' The resulting corner from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
31' An attempted cross from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.

30' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Zion Suzuki is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
27' Parma couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
26' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marcenaro signals a set piece.
24' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
21' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) commits a foul and Matteo Marcenaro immediately signals a free kick.
18' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
16' A rebound falls to Jonathan David (Juventus) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.

15' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
14' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is booked.
14' A quickly taken corner by Juventus.

13' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Zion Suzuki is prepared and leaps to thwart him. It will be a corner kick for Juventus.
11' Bremer (Juventus) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.

8' Bremer (Juventus) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marcenaro with no other option than to blow for a foul.
5' Parma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

4' Mathias Lovik (Parma) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Parma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' An accurate cross finds its way to Khephren Thuram (Juventus) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper makes the save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Juventus will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matteo Marcenaro.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
